name: The Branch of Cenarius
summary: In eastern Ashenvale, Anilia's final plea sends you after the Branch of Cenarius. Geltharis has taken the sacred relic, and Illiyana waits for its return.

sections.title: A Dying Request
sections.body: You find Anilia near death while searching eastern Ashenvale for missing dryads. The wounded daughter of Cenarius points north, toward the satyr ruins. With her last breaths, she names Geltharis as the one who took the Branch of Cenarius and begs you to recover it.

sections.title: Corruption in the Ruins
sections.body: Geltharis hides among the ancient elven ruins of Xavian. The satyrs are ancient servants of the Burning Legion, and they prize relics tied to Cenarius as trophies to defile and mock. Taking the branch from Geltharis can answer Anilia's plea and help defend Ashenvale's sacred plants from the corruption these servants spread.

sections.title: Sorrow Among the Dryads
sections.body: You return the branch to Illiyana, but Anilia is gone. The sacred relic is safe from demonic corruption, while the news of Anilia's death grieves her surviving kin. The dryads of Ashenvale must face war and the corruption closing in around them.

faq.q: What is the Branch of Cenarius?
faq.answer: The Branch of Cenarius is a sacred nature relic linked to the forest lord Cenarius and cherished by his dryad daughters. Satyrs took it, and Anilia was mortally wounded while leading her sisters in the effort to recover it; with her last breath, she named Geltharis as the thief.
Anilia was fatally wounded in the satyr-held ruins of Xavian while trying to recover the Branch of Cenarius. With her dying breath, she named Geltharis as the satyr who took it.
Geltharis hides in the Xavian ruins, north of where Anilia lay dying.

faq.q: Where do I take the Branch of Cenarius once it is recovered?
faq.answer: Take the recovered branch to Illiyana at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why do the satyrs want Cenarius's artifacts?
faq.answer: Satyrs are ancient night elves transformed by demonic pacts. They hate nature and Cenarius, and stealing or corrupting sacred relics serves their demonic masters and their spite against their former kin.
Anilia and Illiyana were close dryad companions, sisters in spirit who spent countless days running and playing freely in Ashenvale's wilds before corruption's dangers took Anilia's life.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Cenarius's daughters as beloved allies. Avenge Anilia and purge the satyrs defiling your ancestral forests.
As a druid, you hold Cenarius's relics sacred because he taught the first mortal druids. Reclaiming his branch from a demon-tainted satyr is a spiritual imperative.
As an Alliance member, you can aid Ashenvale's dryads as they push back demonic threats in the untamed east.
